partnershipPlan: Two members of the day surgery patient panel review the plain-language summary; recovery nurses review the case definition.
socialListening: No social media listening; the unit's patient experience comments for the last year are read for mentions of nausea and overnight stays.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I had arranged for my daughter to take me home and ended up on a ward overnight because I could not stop being sick.
items.implication: Delayed discharge is part of the case definition.

items.theme: The score at the end of a list
items.quote: Composite paraphrase (anaesthetist): By the fifth case of the afternoon I give what I always give; the score is on the form but I do not look.
items.implication: Adherence may vary through the list; record case order.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (recovery nurse): The ones who got everything are not sick, they are asleep, and they still miss their lift home.

summary: Three composite voices on unplanned stays, list fatigue and sedation.
